title: Protect Yourself from Blue Light
passage:
Our eyes need light to see. Light we can see comes in several different colors. Each color has a different amount of energy. Blue light has the most energy and is very common in electric lights. When we turn on a computer, TV, or phone, they all produce blue light. Our eyes are bad at blocking it because it's very strong. People worry about this because too much blue light causes damage.

The most dangerous blue light comes from screens. Looking at them too much can cause eye pain. Blue light also affects your sleep. Your body is fooled into thinking it's a different time of day, so it stops producing the chemical that helps you fall asleep. Too much blue light can even make you blind.

We shouldn't avoid all blue light, as it improves our mood during the day. However, it is advised to protect our eyes from it. Some special glasses and apps block blue light. Something that could make a difference is to follow the 20-20-20 method. Every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. It gives your eyes the rest that they need.
